sentences.text:
This appeal is filed by the injured claimant seeking enhancement of compensation being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 10.02.2021, passed in MVC No.271/2019 on the file of the Prl.
Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Jamkhandi.
2. Shri Siddappa Sajjan, learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal committed an error in assessing the disability and had awarded meager compensation on all other heads.

Hence,
he seeks for allowing of the appeal.

3. Per contra, Shri Hanumanthreddy Sahukar, learned counsel for respondent No.1 and Shri R.S.
Arani, learned counsel for respondent No.2 in chorus submits that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and it does not call for any enhancement.

Thus, they seeks for dismissal of the appeal.
NC: 2024:KHC-D:11479 4.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and perused the appeal papers meticulously.
5. The pleadings and evidence on record indicate that in a road traffic accident which occurred on 28.08.2018, the claimant had suffered grievous injuries.
In support of the same, the claimant examined the Doctor Naveen S/o. Basavaraj Malagi as PW2 and produced the disability certificate.
Taking note of the injuries suffered by the claimant, I am of the considered view that it would be just and appropriate to reassess the disability of the claimant at 11%.
Further, the Tribunal has rightly assessed the income of the claimant and multiplier based on the age of the claimant at the time of accident.

Thus, the loss of income due to disability is reassessed at Rs.1,70,610/- (Rs.11,750/- x 12 x 11 x 11%).
6.

Taking note of the treatment provided to the injured-appellant/claimant, I reassess the compensation awarded under the head "Pain & Suffering" at Rs.40,000/- as against Rs.25,000/-
awarded by the Tribunal.
The NC: 2024:KHC-D:11479 Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.10,000/- towards "Food & diet", which is on the lower side, hence, I reassess the same to Rs.20,000/-.
Further, the compensation of Rs.1,07,943/- towards "medical expenses" and Rs.25,000/- towards "future medical expenses" awarded by the Tribunal are retained as it is.

Further, considering the nature of injuries suffered by the claimant, this Court award a sum of Rs.30,000/- towards "loss of amenities".
7.

Further, the appellant has sustained the aforesaid injuries, fractures and was admitted as an inpatient in the Hospital for a substantial period, hence, I am of the considered view that the Sri. sentences.text: injured-

appellant/claimant requires at least three month period to recover, so it would be just and proper to award Rs.35,250/- (Rs.11,750/- x 3 months) under the head "loss of income during the period of treatment".

8. Thus, the injured-appellant/claimant would be entitled to modified compensation on the following heads:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:11479

Particulars Amount (in Rs.) Towards disability Rs.1,70,610/-
Towards pain and suffering Rs.40,000/-
Towards food and diet Rs.20,000/-
Towards future medical expenses Rs.25,000/-
Towards medical expenses Rs.1,07,943/-

Loss of income during laid up Rs.35,250/-
 period

Loss of amenities Rs.30,000/-
 Total Rs.4,28,803/-
9.
Thus, the injured-appellant/claimant would be entitled to total compensation of Rs.4,28,803/- as against Rs.3,23,043/- awarded by the Tribunal.

10. In the result, the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal stands allowed in part.

(ii) The impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal is modified to an extent that the injured-appellant/claimant would be entitled to total compensation of Rs.4,28,803/- as against Rs.3,23,043/- awarded by the Tribunal.

(iii) The enhanced compensation amount shall carry interest at the rate of 6% p.a.
from the date of petition till the date of payment.

NC: 2024:KHC-D:11479 (iv) The respondent - Insurance Company to pay the entire compensation amount along with interest to the injured-appellant/claimant within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
(v) Apportionment, deposit and disbursement shall be made as per the award of the Tribunal.
(vi) Draw modified award accordingly.
